entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' to place an order.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex... I... I need to return something. My VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
It's Sarah Miller, order number 788-54-912. I'm just so disappointed.
Okay, Sarah, I have your account pulled up. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just... it's not what I thought it would be. I've read the user manual twice, but it's so confusing. The pulse tracking screen is really hard to use and I just expected more from it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and... honestly, I really needed this money back for some bills. I feel a bit silly for even buying it now.
I understand completely, and I'm sorry for the frustrating experience. Let me just quickly review our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I hope you can help.

Alright, Sarah, thanks for your patience. I see here that your VeloBand was delivered 20 days ago, on December 15th. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that window.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Are you sure?

Absolutely. I've gone ahead and approved the return in our system. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
Wow. Thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea how much this helps. You've been wonderful.
You are very welcome, Sarah. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
